title: Regenerate test/vectors/tunnel_authorization.json for AddrForKey + 16-byte-hop route_hash
description: Shared corpus for 5muj + its Rust/Python/C children. test/vectors/tunnel_authorization.json embeds the REJECTED derivation (identity address_hex = 02 + iid doubling, e.g. root 02ed4242ead4ac69ed4242ead4ac6948) and route_hash values computed over 8-byte IIDs. After 5muj (spec) and the impl children land: regenerate via test/vectors/generate_tunnel_authorization.py so (1) identity address_hex fields equal upstream AddrForKey(pubkey) (the corpus shares the i72x.6 identity-migration concern), and (2) all route_hash values are computed over full 16-byte hop addresses. The generator must use an INDEPENDENT oracle for the address bytes (upstream address_test.go anchor / pinned vectors), never the impl under test. Land AFTER the Rust/Python/C children so all four consumers flip to the new corpus together. Discovered-from 5muj.
